subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the remaining Discord monitor refactor, with embedded-runner structural work tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072?
rationale: The merged phase decomposition covers a meaningful part of the original embedded-runner concern, but the supplied evidence does not show that the broader roadmap owns the separate Discord coupling work.

options.title: Narrow to Discord cleanup
options.body: Keep this issue as the tracker for splitting Discord preflight, processing, and provider responsibilities, and link embedded-runner phases to the RuntimePlan roadmap.

options.title: Keep the umbrella tracker
options.body: Continue using this issue to coordinate both surfaces, but require each follow-up to preserve separate owner boundaries and land as independent staged PRs.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Discord cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the tracker for splitting Discord preflight, processing, and provider responsibilities, and link embedded-runner phases to the RuntimePlan roadmap.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows direct recent ownership of the embedded-attempt decomposition and prior review of this tracker.
